''See also: [[Vessels Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Vessels are awakened objects that serve as the source of power for individuals known as [[Soulbound]]. While these objects can be small and unobtrusive, they are often large-scale entities such as ships. To become a [[Vessel]], an object must be invested with specific intent and significance, typically by incorporating parts of an Elder or a [[Kameira]]—such as bone, blood, or artifacts—into its construction. This connection allows [[Soulbound]] individuals to navigate the dangerous [[Aion Sea]] and utilize extraordinary abilities. In the case of ships, being a [[Vessel]] means the craft is bound to its captain. These vessels are not passive; they possess their own wills and can communicate with their users through impulses, impressions, or internal voices. Some vessels are designed for combat and may actively yearn to fight alongside their crews. Because the connection is so vital, a [[Soulbound]]'s power can be neutralized by identifying and destroying their [[Vessel]]. While most people possess a single object, some rare individuals may manage multiple Vessels, though this carries the risk of the objects' conflicting personalities overwhelming the user.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Vessels are floating entities that can be contained within sealing boxes. During her interactions with the [[Farstriders]], [[Shera]] instructs them to release their own Vessels, while [[Estyr]] is observed keeping her Vessels on a table nearby. These items possess the ability to provide voices that can slam into a user's head. In [[Shera]]'s experience, the Vessels delivered an impulse that drowned out her thoughts before they spoke in unison to command her to flee.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Vessels]] are entities that can float.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Vessels]] are items that can be placed in sealing boxes.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] tells the [[Farstriders]] to release their [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] has [[Vessels]] sitting on a table next to her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Vessels]] provide voices that can slam into a user's head.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]]'s [[Vessels]] delivered an impulse that drowned out her thoughts.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]]'s [[Vessels]] spoke in unison to tell her to flee.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
